programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We'll walk to the top of the Snowdon mountain; the highest of the "Snowdonia National Park" in Wales. We will climb it in an old railway that was inaugurated in 1896; The Castle of Pembroke built in the year 1093 by the tycoon, Arnulf de Montgomery who during the Norman invasion in Wales; saw the elevated terrain near the "Pembroke River". From those hills full of snow; we descend to the coasts of the "Atlantic Ocean", to go to the South of Europe, and visit a legendary lighthouse that is in the city of Galicia. We will find samples of the first humans of the Middle Paleolithic era, who inhabited this area some 50,000 years ago. Finally, we will go to Venezuela! and we will marvel at the waterfalls of the "Canaima National Park". Of which you will surely fall in love; the most important of them "Salto Angel", with a waterfall of 2650 feet high, and a total height of a staggering 3200 feet high, is the highest waterfall in the world. And there we will fly over the Devils Canyon and see the imposing Tepuyes, which are the oldest rock formations on the planet.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!
